description: Food Assitence for famlies with school-age Children
whatThisIs: [Food Assitence for famlies with school-age Children.]
whoItHelps: Families who rely on school lunches looking for extra food support for their children
Families with school aged children who are currently receiving SNAP, DTA cash benefits, certain types of MassHealth coverage, SSI with a relative caregiver, or is in foster care.
whatToKnow: The SUN buck program does automatically enroll some individuals but you may also apply on the DTA’s website.
The SUN buck’ application does not close once summer begins, the summer 2026 Application closed September 6th 2026. The Summer 2027 portal had already opened for applications
name: SUN Bucks
